result.disclaimer: Literature/patent-reported IC50; no efficacy, safety or suitability claim.
result.fold_grouping: GroupKFold in both loops, using saved Gate 2 exact scaffold labels; acyclic empty scaffolds stay together, even for random-split training.

grid_rationale.baseline_in_grid: max_features=1.0 with min_samples_leaf=1 reproduces the Gate 3 forest, so the tuned control's candidate set contains the untuned baseline.
grid_rationale.compute: Default grid: eight candidates; fits run one after another, each forest using n_jobs workers. Completed fits are cached individually, including timing, so interruption loses at most one fit.
grid_rationale.max_features: sqrt(p), 10%, 33% and 100% vary feature competition and tree diversity, especially for dense descriptors alongside sparse Morgan bits. 100% is the Gate 3 setting and, on the 12-column descriptor block, the only value that lets a split consider every descriptor (sqrt and 33% both round to 3 there, 10% to 1; the duplicate resolves by grid order).
grid_rationale.min_samples_leaf: 1 versus 3 tests modest regularisation of the Gate 3 train/test gap.
grid_rationale.n_estimators: Fixed at the Gate 3 count, not selected; more trees reduce Monte Carlo variation. Keeping the count fixed isolates the two search axes.

result.selection_rule: Minimum unweighted mean inner-fold RMSE; ties use logged grid order.

timing.note: Cumulative fit times include reused work; invocation time may be a resumed run. Cached reports retain their original timings. n_jobs is the worker count of the invocation that completed the report; each cached fit records its own.

result.uncertainty: Whole-scaffold percentile bootstrap conditions on these fixed OOF predictions and folds; excludes selection/refit/split-seed uncertainty. Fold SD is descriptive, not a confidence interval: training folds overlap.
